pages.lesson:
LESSON: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it
   In simple words: practise until you can recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an in the examples.
2. Explain Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
4. Show that you can: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Modes of preservation of the Qur’an important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read chapters/verses from the Qur’an,
2. Self-efficacy: Enhanced as learners acquire personal skills as they recite some chapters/verses of the Qur’an
3. Communication and collaboration: Enhanced as learners acquire the skills of listening and respecting other people’s views when discussing the significance of preserving the Qur’an in groups.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?
2. How is the Qur’an preserved in modern times?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
